title:
A Study of Amivantamab in Addition to Standard of Care Agents Compared with Standard of
Care in Participants With Recurrent/Metastatic Head and Neck Cancer
official:
A Phase 3, Randomized, Open-Label, Multicenter Study of Amivantamab in Addition to
Carboplatin and Pembrolizumab, Compared to Standard of Care Platinum and
Pembrolizumab and 5-FU, in Participants with Treatment-Naïve Recurrent/Metastatic
Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma
summary: Main objective: To compare anti-tumor activity
conditions: Treatment-Naïve Recurrent/Metastatic Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma
Squamous cell carcinoma of head and neck metastatic
Squamous cell carcinoma of head and neck recurrent
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1. Have histologically or cytologically confirmed R/M HNSCC that is considered incurable by local therapies.
2. 2. Be treatment-naïve for systemic therapy in the R/M setting.
3. 3. 18 years and older with ECOG 0-1
4. 4. Have measurable disease according to RECIST v1.1
Exclusion criteria:
1. 1. Uncontrolled illness
2. 2. Has untreated brain metastases or history or known presence of leptomeningeal disease
3. 3. Has a history of clinically significant cardiovascular disease
4. 4. Inadequate organ or bone marrow function
